Chapter 6617: Reaching The New Shore Through Old Ways

Chapter 6617: Reaching The New Shore Through Old Ways

Grand Preceptor’s dao and space became one, resembling a spring with new dao laws and runes gushing out.

From old came the new and improved to everyone’s astonishment.

“The constant transformation of the dao.” A primal ancestor was in awe.

The Grand Preceptor’s path had a significant influence on the history of Three Immortals. Although he didn’t create something earthshattering, he gave everyone a foundation for improvement. Those who tried to become an emperor or desolate gods could transform the old into the new instead of conjuring something out of thin air.

“Excuse me.” Dugu Yuan said politely before raising his voice: “Break!”

“Buzz.” The sword precisely pierced the grand dao without harming the spatial fabrics. Keep in mind the profundity of a primal ancestor’s dao.

Normally, it had to be overwhelmed with raw power or another dao. Nullifying it would take too long. However, Dugu Yuan struck the weak spot with flawless precision and speed.

“Boom!” The ancient dao collapsed, appearing feeble when it was anything but.

“Dao Break Variation.” Light God was amazed.

“New Shore.” The defeat of an old dao gave birth to a new one. The broken runes came together to trap Dugu Yuan.

This new dao resembled the distant shore, dragging Dugu Yuan from this world to another dimension.

“From old to new, I see. Not bad at all!” Visceraless commented excitedly.

“The fourth primal ancestor, truly impressive.” Others sang praises of him.

In just a short time, the two exchanged blows evenly. One was on the offensive with a barrage of dao while the other nullified them effectively.

***

Meanwhile, Li Qiye stepped into the heavenly dao, following Calamities.

The crack had closed and no one else could find it. However, Li Qiye knew this dao came from World Seal. It had gestated for eras and finally birthed its own dao.

The dao couldn’t be found because it hid everywhere on the timeline. It had formed its own world with wondrous visual phenomena.

An immortal sword with rampaging energy was spotted. Another included a soaring phoenix capable of creation. One displayed a technique capable of ending all lives...

Thus, the images contained both wonders and dangers. To the center was a ferocious battle. Just remnant shockwaves alone could put an end to Three Immortals.

A boundless tribulation ocean could be seen expanding rapidly. Calamities still fought with the heavenly dao, not holding back in the slightest against this world’s core.

He had every tribulation one could think of - blood curses, physical destruction, and more potent versions...

The core of the dao pulsed unstably from the endless barrages. Nevertheless, it created more visual phenomena to throw at him.

The next one consisted of an evil jar sucking in all the tribulations. Another was a heavenly mirror reflecting the tribulations towards Calamities. The third was a slashing saber, cutting down the bolts in its path and forcing Calamities back...

The dao core seemingly used its phenomena to suppress Calamities, wanting to replicate him.
